label: Bible Study
prompt: He that spareth his _____ hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verse: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
note: An old line on discipline — the point is love that bothers to correct.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the _____ of the world.
verse: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
note: John the Baptist sees Jesus coming and introduces Him with one picture: the Lamb of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of _____, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verse: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
note: Lydia, a seller of purple from Thyatira, opened her heart to Paul's message — and then her home (Acts 16:15).

label: Deep Water
prompt: Keep back thy servant also from _____ sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verse: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
note: Hidden faults in verse 12, deliberate sins here — David asks to be kept from both.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask _____, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
verse: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
note: Unanswered prayer, diagnosed: ye ask 'amiss' — wrongly — to spend it on your own lusts.
